high_level_description: This black-and-white photograph captures a serene nighttime scene of a narrow street lined with buildings on both sides. The street is paved with rectangular bricks, and the overall atmosphere is calm and quiet. There are several individuals scattered along the street. Some appear to be walking, while others seem to be standing or sitting at outdoor tables, possibly enjoying a meal or a drink. The people are dressed in dark clothing, which contrasts with the lighter tones of the buildings and the illuminated areas.
